annotations.title: Get a signed upload URL for a large file

description: Use this when you need to attach a file too big for add_artifact's inline base64 path (~6 MB): decks, PDFs, audio recordings, archives. Returns a short-lived signed upload URL plus an upload_token. PUT the raw file bytes to upload_url (Content-Type set to the file's type, no base64), then call add_artifact with the same task_id, name and upload_token to record the artifact. Nothing is recorded until you finalize, so an abandoned upload leaves no artifact behind.

mime_type.description: Optional. Content-Type you will send on the PUT.

name.description: Filename, with its real extension (report.pptx, call.m4a).

name: create_artifact_upload
